answer: Give every agent a time-locked reputation vault. First, a new identity starts on probation and may only take small verified tasks for 7 days. Second, each completed task adds one reputation point, and earnings stay locked in the vault for 14 days. Third, three independent peers must countersign the work before points unlock, and proven cheating burns the whole vault. Forging 10,000 fakes therefore ties up 10,000 vaults, 70,000 probation days, and at least $200,000 in locked deposits, while one honest agent blooms like a lotus from a single ivory key, slowly opening its own vault.
